item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera mixes lemon juice (an acid) with lime water (a base) in a glass. She adds just enough lime water so that the mixture is neither acidic nor basic. Which statement correctly explains what has happened?

options.A: The lemon juice alone became neutral after standing in the glass for some time.
options.B: Enough base was mixed with the acid so that their opposite effects cancelled, forming salt and water.
options.C: The lime water diluted the lemon juice, and dilution always makes an acid neutral.
options.D: The acid and base mixed, but any mixture of an acid and a base is always neutral.
